args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. Redraw the HANGING SNAKE from the first reference drawing: a lime-green snake with a glossy highlight stripe, hanging VERTICALLY head-down from a small puffy pink cloud at the top of each frame, head at the bottom with angry eyebrows, two round eyes with white shine and a pink forked tongue. NO side bump on the body. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, plenty of empty space between frames. Frames: (1) just the pink cloud with a tiny bit of tail peeking out; (2) body halfway unrolled down; (3) fully dropped, head low; (4)-(6) fully hanging swaying left, center, right; (7) tongue flicking out; (8) eyebrows relaxed into a pout with a sad little mouth. Each frame is about 70 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
